title: Polygonatum polysaccharide improves cognitive function in senescence-accelerated mice by regulating ferroptosis through the cAMP/PKA/CREB pathway: transcriptomics-based and in vivo experimental validation.
authors: Xiao, Lan; OuYang, Yin; Fu, Yan; Yi, Jian; Chen, Bowei; Peng, Sha; Zeng, Fanzuo; Zhang, WenFang; Liu, Baiyan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄精多糖通过cAMP/PKA/CREB通路抑制铁死亡改善衰老小鼠认知功能，核心为药理学与转录组学，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Cognitive decline is a core feature of aging and related neurodegenerative diseases. Polygonatum odoratum, a traditional Chinese medicine used to tonify qi and nourish yin, is a classic herbal remedy for cognitive impairment. Its active component, Polygonatum polysaccharide (POP), exhibits antioxidant and anti-aging potential. Our group's prior research demonstrated that POP could improve age-related cognitive decline. The pathogenesis of cognitive impairment is closely linked to the activation of neuronal ferroptosis, making targeted inhibition of neuronal ferroptosis a highly promising new approach for intervening in cognitive decline. Against this backdrop, whether and how POP suppresses ferroptosis to improve cognitive function warrants attention. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aims to elucidate the potential mechanism by which POP mediates the cAMP/PKA/CREB pathway to inhibit ferroptosis and improve cognitive dysfunction in rapidly aging mice. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Six-month-old SAMP8 mice were administered multiple doses of POP. Cognitive function decline improvement in SAMP8 mice was verified by comparing water maze performance and pathological damage across groups, and the optimal dose of POP for cognitive enhancement was determined. Finally, the mechanism by which POP improves cognitive dysfunction in SAMP8 mice was validated using transcriptomics and in vivo experiments. RESULTS: Behavioral studies and histopathological staining demonstrated that POP significantly reduced the latency period in mice, extended the dwell time in the target quadrant, and increased the number of platform crossings (P < 0.01), thereby enhancing cognitive function in SAMP8 mice. Transcriptomic analysis and in vivo experiments further confirmed that the POP group exhibited decreased expression of Acsl4 and increased expression of Slc7A11 (P < 0.05). Additionally, POP was found to activate the cAMP/PKA/CREB signaling pathway, as evidenced by decreased levels of Fe(2+) and MDA and significantly increased levels of GSH and SOD (P < 0.05 or P < 0.01), thereby reducing ferroptosis in the brain. Protein docking and co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP) results indicated a strong affinity between the cAMP pathway and proteins associated with ferroptosis. CONCLUSION: This study demonstrates that POP improves cognitive function in SAMP8 mice by mediating the cAMP/PKA/CREB pathway to inhibit ferroptosis. It reveals the potential mechanism of action of POP and further confirms its efficacy in ameliorating age-related cognitive decline.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：认知衰退是衰老及相关神经退行性疾病的核心特征。玉竹（Polygonatum odoratum）是一种用于补气养阴的传统中药，是治疗认知障碍的经典草药。其活性成分玉竹多糖（POP）具有抗氧化和抗衰老潜力。我们课题组先前的研究表明，POP能够改善年龄相关的认知衰退。认知障碍的发病机制与神经元铁死亡（ferroptosis）的激活密切相关，因此靶向抑制神经元铁死亡是干预认知衰退的一种极具前景的新方法。在此背景下，POP是否以及如何通过抑制铁死亡来改善认知功能值得关注。研究目的：本研究旨在阐明POP介导cAMP/PKA/CREB通路抑制铁死亡并改善快速老化小鼠认知功能障碍的潜在机制。材料与方法：对6月龄SAMP8小鼠给予多剂量POP。通过比较各组水迷宫表现和病理损伤，验证POP对SAMP8小鼠认知功能衰退的改善作用，并确定POP增强认知的最佳剂量。最后，利用转录组学和体内实验验证POP改善SAMP8小鼠认知功能障碍的机制。结果：行为学研究和组织病理学染色表明，POP显著缩短了小鼠的潜伏期，延长了目标象限停留时间，并增加了穿越平台次数（P < 0.01），从而增强了SAMP8小鼠的认知功能。转录组学分析和体内实验进一步证实，POP组中Acsl4表达降低，Slc7A11表达升高（P < 0.05）。此外，POP被发现激活cAMP/PKA/CREB信号通路，表现为Fe(2+)和MDA水平降低，GSH和SOD水平显著升高（P < 0.05或P < 0.01），从而减少脑内铁死亡。蛋白质对接和免疫共沉淀（Co-IP）结果表明，cAMP通路与铁死亡相关蛋白之间具有强亲和力。结论：本研究证明POP通过介导cAMP/PKA/CREB通路抑制铁死亡来改善SAMP8小鼠的认知功能。这揭示了POP的潜在作用机制，并进一步证实了其在改善年龄相关认知衰退方面的功效。
